shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 600 package-lock.json; git ls-files
cat index.html src/*.ts* tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls -R __agent_eval__ | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls node_modules | head -50

cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60; ls node_modules/@tanstack node_modules/@hello-pangea node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -150; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -3; git status --short

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && grep -E '"(version|dependencies|peerDependencies)"' -A8 uikit/package.json | head -40; ls icons/ | grep -E '^(House|Persons|ShoppingCart|Gear|ChevronsLeft|ChevronsRight|ChevronRight|ChevronDown|Bars|Grip|GripVertical|Xmark|Funnel|Layers)' ; grep -n "theme" uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts | head; grep -n "indeterminate\|size" uikit/build/esm/components/controls/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep version node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls; grep -n "Icon\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Icon/Icon.d.ts | head -5

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts | head -50; grep -n "indeterminate" -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/common/*.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "content\|placement\|openDelay" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.d.ts | head

grep -n "ControlProps" -A25 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | grep -n "indeterminate\|checked\|onUpdate\|onChange\|ControlProps" ; grep -rn "indeterminate" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/*.d.ts | head -4; grep -n "ControlProps" -B2 -A25 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -50

rm -rf dist && sed -i 's|"@gravity-ui/uikit": "7.43.0",|"@gravity-ui/icons": "^2.16.0",\n    "@gravity-ui/uikit": "7.43.0",|' package.json && npm install --package-lock-only --offline 2>&1 | tail -3; git diff package.json; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -6; rm -rf dist; git status --short
